turns.q: Add that one to my cart and tell me the total with any discount.
Does the cheaper one have the same warranty as the pricier one?
turns.replyTail:
you’re comparing the two regular items, the cheaper one has the same standard warranty as the pricier one, as long as it’s an eligible item purchased directly from our website. The standard coverage is 30 days from the order date for approved defects, such as a broken clasp or missing stone.

The optional EVRY Protection Plan extends defect coverage to one year and also includes package protection. It must be selected at checkout, and it isn’t based on the item’s price.

turns.q: Can I pay in installments or split payment?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, Bestie. Afterpay is available for North American orders, so you can use it for installment-style payments if it appears as an option at checkout.

We also accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay. Debit cards and prepaid cards are not accepted.
